Uncovered cross-characteristic Lie families with order divisible by the ground characteristic.
General monolithic nonabelian crowns with permutation, field or semilinear actions; selected simple-product bounds alone do not suffice.
Full finite generation for the residual nonprojective normal proper surface punctures and original-boundary tame quotients.

auxiliary_not_movement: Ten post19 units have completed all four actual-file/source audits and are assembled: weighted component and background budgets; fixed-determinant normal bundles; compressed-minor and moving-line Cech backgrounds; actual coefficient-gerbe extension; paired finite-jet unit-Isom and clopen classes.
The controlled-anchor lemma is a prerequisite; only its completed synthesis into the uniform one-curve projective representation count is recorded as one strict main-gate reduction.

Finite Hom, uniform twisted normal depth, known-theorem closure, source searches, audits, compilation, actual image checks and packaging do not by themselves shrink any strongest main gate.
